name: les-borkowski
description: Les Borkowski's Claude Code plugins: expediter (agent workflow) and warden (security scanning).

plugins.name: expediter
plugins.description: An orchestrator that calls feature tickets to role agents and checks every result before it ships — plan on a strong model, build on a cheap one. Stack-neutral; reads project specifics from CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: expediter-handoff
plugins.description: /handoff writes the expediter resume checkpoint and clears the conversation. Needs the expediter plugin for resume.

plugins.name: warden
plugins.description: Security scanning MCP server: pinned scanners, agent triage, finding lifecycle. Needs the warden CLI installed (see its README).
